name: beauessence-appointment-platform
description: Enterprise appointment platform workspace for Beau Essence Clinic.

scripts.build: corepack pnpm --recursive --if-present run build && corepack pnpm run sync:domain && corepack pnpm run build:web
scripts.check:capture-config: tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck --module ESNext --moduleResolution Bundler --target ES2022 --types node playwright.screenshots.config.ts
scripts.check:supply-chain: corepack pnpm run check:secrets && corepack pnpm run check:audit-exceptions && corepack pnpm run audit:prod && corepack pnpm run audit:all && corepack pnpm run sbom
scripts.verify: node scripts/check-structure.mjs && corepack pnpm run check:architecture && corepack pnpm run check:ui && corepack pnpm run check:pages && corepack pnpm run check:tokens && corepack pnpm run check:docs && corepack pnpm run check:secrets && corepack pnpm run check:format && corepack pnpm run check:capture-config && corepack pnpm run check:types && corepack pnpm run check:lint && corepack pnpm run check:sync && corepack pnpm run check:perf && corepack pnpm run test:unit
